title: Connexions de Gauss-Manin et équations de Picard-Fuchs. Opération de Cartier : copies de tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), tiré à part (1981), notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: X is a smooth curve over a base S (relative uniformizing parameters t, s; a ∈ Γ(S,O_S^*), b ∈ Γ(S,O_S)), and \underline{ω} is the relative cotangent sheaf.

(1) Let ω be a local generator of \underline{ω}^{⊗n}, n ≠ 0, i.e. a nowhere-vanishing n-differential. Then ω^{1/n} is a generator of \underline{ω}, defined locally up to multiplication by ε with ε^n = 1. Its primitive ∫ω^{1/n} is defined up to F ↦ εF + b. The class of this primitive modulo projective (Möbius) transformations, written ^c∫ω^{1/n}, is therefore well defined. Taking it as a projective coordinate gives a projective structure, i.e. a projective connection c_n(ω), canonically attached to any invertible n-differential. Write c_t for the projective connection for which the coordinate t itself is projective.

(2) With ω = f(t) dt^n, one has ω^{1/n} = f^{1/n} dt. The page computes
c_n(ω) = c_t + [ −(2/n) f''/f + ((2n+1)/n^2) (f'/f)^2 ] dt^2.
This is c_t − 2·{F,t} dt^2, where {F,t} is the Schwarzian derivative of F = ∫ f^{1/n} dt. Check: F''/F' = (1/n) f'/f, so {F,t} = (1/n) f''/f − ((2n+1)/(2n^2)) (f'/f)^2. Hence the normalization is 'projective connection = −2 × Schwarzian'.

(3) Define G_{m,n}(ω_m, ϖ_n) = c_n(ϖ_n) − c_m(ω_m), a quadratic differential, for an m-differential ω_m and an n-differential ϖ_n. The degree-0 case is included: a '0-differential' is a coordinate function s, with c_0(s) = c_s. G(t,s) = G_{0,0}(t,s) is the Schwarzian-type quadratic differential of s relative to t. The page lists the formal properties:
- additive cocycle: G_{m,n} + G_{n,p} = G_{m,p};
- power invariance: G_{m,n}(ω_m, ω_n) = G_{m,nr}(ω_m, ω_n^r), because (ω^r)^{1/nr} = ω^{1/n} up to roots of unity;
- compatibility with n = 0: G_{m,n}(ω_m, (ds)^n) = G_{m,0}(ω_m, s), and G_{m,n}((dt)^m, (ds)^n) = G_{0,0}(t,s);
- Möbius invariance: G(t, as) = G(t, s + b) = G(t, 1/s) = G(t, s).
So G is a 'universal Schwarzian' defined on the groupoid of all invertible n-differentials for all n ∈ Z, with coordinates in degree 0.

(4) Denominator clearing. Set c'_n = n^2 c_n, then rescaled with a /12. Its correction term −2n f''/f + (2n+1)(f'/f)^2 is polynomial in n. For two degrees m, n choose δ = mα = nβ, so δ^2 = m^2α^2 = n^2β^2. Then α^2 c'_m(ω_m) = δ^2 c_m/12 and β^2 c'_n(ω'_n) = δ^2 c_n/12 both land in the same torsor, under Γ(τ_X^{⊗δ^2}) as written. Their difference G'_{m,n} is a denominator-free variant of G_{m,n}. This is presumably aimed at positive or mixed characteristic, consistent with the folder's Cartier-operator theme.

(5) The bottom of the page is fragmentary scratch work with notation f_p, b_p, and ₂(f/f_p); also implications such as a = (b/f)_p ⇐ ∫(b/b_p) = ∫(f/f_p) and b_p = f_p. Plausibly it determines when two functions have the same G (the same Schwarzian): f ~ b up to affine/Möbius maps, possibly with p-th-power coefficients in characteristic p. It is too fragmentary to reconstruct reliably.

The next page (uniformization, \hat T_X, Π_1, E = Ω^{-1}⊕Ω^0, Ě⊗E, counts 3g−3, 4g−2) shows the context: projective structures / uniformization of curves via the rank-2 jet bundle, i.e. the classical Gunning picture of projective connections as opers.
errors: In the second term of G_{m,n}, the factor (g'/g)^2 should be (f'/f)^2, since that term is c_m(ω_m) with ω_m = f dt^m. This is a slip of the pen.

Normalization is inconsistent: c'_n is first defined as n^2 c_n, later as n^2 c_n/12, so the /12 normalization is ambiguous. The target 'Γτ_X^{⊗δ^2}' is dimensionally odd for a difference of projective connections, which should be a quadratic differential. Probably a notation for a twisted or rescaled torsor that is not explained on the page.
The final lines (f_p, b_p, ₂(·)) are fragmentary and possibly erroneous or abandoned; no conclusion is stated.

ideas.what: Projective connection canonically attached to a nowhere-vanishing n-differential via the projective class of ∫ω^{1/n}
ideas.modern_name: projective structure induced by a holomorphic n-differential (flat / translation-type structure); Schwarzian of the developing map
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Schwarz, Poincaré); projective connections on curves: Gunning (1966), Hubbard; n-differential flat structures folklore (Strebel for n=2)

ideas.what: Explicit formula c_n(fdt^n) − c_t = [−(2/n) f''/f + ((2n+1)/n^2)(f'/f)^2] dt^2
Cocycle G_{m,n} on invertible differentials of all degrees n∈Z, with coordinates as degree 0: additivity, power invariance, Möbius invariance
ideas.modern_name: Schwarzian cocycle / difference of projective connections as a torsor under quadratic differentials
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical cocycle property of the Schwarzian (Cayley chain rule); torsor viewpoint: Gunning, Deligne

ideas.what: Denominator-cleared variant n^2 c_n (and δ = lcm rescaling) making the formula polynomial in n, presumably for use in characteristic p alongside the Cartier operator
ideas.modern_name: integral models of projective connections / opers in positive characteristic (cf. dormant opers, Ihara's Schwarzian in char p)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ihara (1970s), Mochizuki (p-adic Teichmüller theory, 1990s), Joshi–Pauly, Wakabayashi

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up a unified Schwarzian cocycle G_{m,n} on all n-differentials, n ∈ Z, including coordinates as n = 0, then rescales by n^2 (and δ = lcm) to remove denominators. This apparently aims at a characteristic-free or char-p theory of projective connections tied to the Cartier operator. The thread is not completed on the page.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is an early (≤1981) instance of Grothendieck thinking about projective structures in a Gauss–Manin/Cartier context. That context foreshadows Mochizuki's p-adic Teichmüller theory and dormant opers; it is mainly of historical interest since the mathematics itself is classical.

deep.surprise_reason: The computations are classical Schwarzian/projective-connection identities, correctly done apart from a slip. The only notable points are the systematic n ∈ Z cocycle packaging, the denominator-clearing aimed apparently at characteristic p, and the documentary evidence of Grothendieck working on projective structures/uniformization in this folder.
transcription_corrections: 'défini à loc. [?] mult. [?] près ε' likely reads 'défini à la mult. près par ε, ε^n=1'.
The second (f'/f)-type term in G_{m,n} is written (g'/g)^2 in the manuscript but should mathematically be (f'/f)^2.
'c_t+' after ^c∫f^{1/n}dt is written as '= c_t +' above the line, indicating the expansion that follows.
